evidenceOrigin.note: The full CI artifact records the individual warm samples and compiler evidence. This checked-in compact observation preserves the findings after CI artifacts expire.

metric: median materialized-score decode latency divided by online-attention decode latency; >1 favors online

pretrained.parity: Full native CI trained-model witness passed including independent NumPy logits and final KV states.

synthetic.parity: All candidate geometries passed independent NumPy prefill/decode logit and final KV checks.

decision: Do not switch the default from materialized_scores; retain opt-in online kernel for bounded research and future profiling.
limitations: Two variants of the same bounded Llama-specific native decoder, not a general IR code generator.
At most 64-token context sweep and 1–2 layer tiny programs; not production long-context serving.
Shared CI runner and three trials per case; ratios are noisy and shape-dependent.
Eliminating one small scores vector does not demonstrate lower process peak RSS or energy consumption.
No measured GPU or photonic hardware backend.
